Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Rishabh - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Isha - 8 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Sunita - 37 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Anil - 46 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Isha and Sunita stand near him.]

Rishabh: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Rishabh folds his hands and prays.]

Rishabh: "What happened?"

[Rishabh lights a diya.]

Rishabh: "Yes, of course."

[Isha draws a rangoli at the door.]

Sunita (gently): "Well done!"

[Rishabh paints a picture.]

Rishabh: "Mom, listen!"

[Rishabh draws a picture of the house.]

Rishabh: "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The road - Day

Sunita: "Let's begin."

[Father rides the bicycle with Rishabh sitting on the carrier behind him.]

Rishabh: "Mom, look at this."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Rishabh stands in the living room. Sunita and Isha stand near him.]

Rishabh: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Rishabh: "And then?"

[Rishabh mops the floor.]

Rishabh (gently): "Hey, look at that!"

[Rishabh irons his school shirt.]

Sunita (excited): "Good job, Rishabh!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Sunita and Isha stand near him.]

Isha: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh opens his umbrella.]

Rishabh: "That was fun!"

[Rishabh puts on his raincoat.]

Rishabh: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
